native.ud_dst_port: Actual destination port in destination-IP context.

native.ud_payload: Actual particular UDP datagram data length, not API buffer/message chunk.
native.ud_datagram_bytes: Actual header+data total; ordinary upperbound65535, jumbo distinct.

native.ud_checksum: Actual 16-bit onwire checksum; calculated0 representedFFFF when enabled.
native.ud_computed_checksum: Actual independent ones-complement calculation before wire0 mapping.
native.ud_ip_header_bytes: Actual IPv4 base/options or IPv6 base plus all preceding extensions.
native.ud_ip_packet_bytes: Actual full IP packet header+UDP datagram.
native.ud_ip_payload_length: Actual IPv6 payload length field, zero in Jumbo packet.
native.ud_extension_bytes: Actual IPv6 extensions between40-byte base andUDP, not included pseudoheader UDP length.
native.ud_jumbo_payload_length: Actual32-bit IPv6 Jumbo option includes extensions plus UDP.
native.ud_pseudo_length: Actual upperlayer UDP length in pseudoheader, even when wire length0.
native.ud_path_mtu: Actual independently discovered allhop MTU, not default1500.
native.ud_first_hop_mtu: Actual outgoing interface MTU for fallback/maximum probing.
native.ud_peer_emtu_r: Actual receiver reassembly/message capacity, independently learned.
native.ud_emtu_s: Actual conservative effective send IPsize, min(576,firsthop)IPv4 or1280IPv6.
native.ud_max_payload: Actual perpath safe UDP data bytes after every IP/extension/UDP header.
native.ud_min_plpmtu: Actual smallest probed size in chosen packetization-layer units.
native.ud_base_plpmtu: Actual conservative starting probe size in chosen layer units.
native.ud_max_plpmtu: Actual probing ceiling constrained outgoing MTU and learned peer capacity.
native.ud_plpmtu: Actual confirmed size at chosen PL, not current unconfirmed probe.
native.ud_probed_size: Actual tentative probe size; receipt acknowledgment required before increasing.
native.ud_max_probes: Actual configured consecutive probe cap; RFC default3.
native.ud_probe_timer_s: Actual probe expiry >=1second and longer than bounded acknowledgment delay.
native.ud_probe_ack_bound_s: Actual worst acknowledgment delay for selected PL mechanism.
native.ud_raise_timer_s: Actual PMTU search maintenance interval; source600seconds proposal.
native.ud_confirmation_timer_s: Actual unacknowledged-PL periodic confirmation interval, below raise timer.
native.ud_send_datagrams_s: Actual application/tunnel offered datagrams persecond across completepath.
native.ud_receiver_count: Actual multicast receivers selected, not one measured path proves all.
native.ud_wire_bytes: Actual complete lower-layer occupied bytes, not UDP header8 alone.
native.ud_age_ms: Actual correlated data age at consumer.
native.ud_freshness_ms: Actual acceptable dataset age, not IPv6 hop limit lifetime.
native.ud_fragment_header: Actual IPv6 fragmentation header presence; forbidden with Jumbo option.
native.ud_fragmentation_allowed: Actual qualified IP fragmentation/reassembly path, not application datagram segmentation.
native.ud_jumbo_path_verified: Actual every peer and link supports Jumbo option/size.
native.ud_tunnel_port_enabled: Actual specifically configured IPv6 zero-checksum destination port.
native.ud_address_checks: Actual validated both IPv6 source/destination addresses for tunnel.
native.ud_inner_integrity: Actual qualifying encapsulated integrity and corruption/misdelivery handling.
native.ud_middleboxes_verified: Actual path including NAT/firewall and change fallback supports zero-checksum tunnel.
native.ud_fallback_full_checksum: Actual Internet path-change safe fallback mechanism.
native.ud_acknowledged_pl: Actual underlying/application packetization layer acknowledges data/probes, UDP itself does not.
native.ud_probe_acked: Actual correlated probe acknowledged by intended peer.
native.ud_ptb_validated: Actual ICMP PTB provenance/correlation validated before size changes.
native.ud_reliable_claimed: Actual application-provided reliable/ordered guarantee, never UDP intrinsic.
native.ud_path_verified: Actual entire selected path/all multicast receivers modeled.
native.ud_data_accepted: Actual current decoded correlated dataset consumed.
native.ud_path_source: Actual selected IP/PHY/MTU/routing/fragment and receiver path.
native.ud_registered_source: Actual qualified extension and its different semantics.
native.ud_tunnel_source: Actual all RFC6936 applicability/implementation/usage requirements assessed.
native.ud_congestion_source: Actual offered-rate control/feedback/fairness mechanisms Internet path.
native.ud_controlled_source: Actual restricted topology/traffic/load controls and exception rationale.
native.ud_probe_source: Actual peer correlated probe acknowledgment/blackhole algorithm.
native.ud_header_hex: Actual8-byte UDP header network-order octets, no automatic complete checksum proof.
native.ud_source_ip: Actual source address in pseudoheader and binding.
native.ud_destination_ip: Actual intended destination address including routing/tunnel qualification.
native.payload_bytes: Actual individual UDP datagram data bytes, separate IP options/extensions/header, jumbogram and allhop MTU. No universal Ethernet or65507 limit.

revisions: RFC768 28August1980 complete UDP header/length/ports/checksum and no guaranteed delivery/duplicate protection.
RFC8085 March2017 sections3/4/5: congestion, message/IP size, reliability, checksum, controlled networks/multicast/ports. Updated DPLPMTUD reference by RFC8899.
RFC2675 August1999 sections2/3/4: IPv6 Jumbo option, no Fragment header, UDP length0 iff datagram>65535, actual length in pseudoheader.
RFC6935 April2013 section2 IPv6 UDP checksums: default nonzero; specifically enabled tunneling exceptions.
RFC6936 April2013 sections4/5/6: assessed zero-checksum tunnel endpoints/address checks/path robustness/encapsulated integrity; not an ordinary application toggle.
RFC8200 July2017 sections4/5/8: IPv6 base40, extensions,1280minimum link, source fragmentation and upper-layer pseudoheader/checksum.
RFC8899 September2020 sections4/5/6.1: DPLPMTUD at one selected layer, acknowledged probes, typed counters/timers and perpath message-size accounting.
scope: All exported UDP fields individually reviewed against original archived RFC sources and isolated tests. Own UDP/IP/PHY path and industry neutral, no CANretry/Ethernetrate/MTU/gateway fallback.
IPv4 and IPv6 normal limits, options/extensions, Jumbo versus ordinary wire and pseudoheader length, no Jumbo fragmentation; complete native8-byte header octets compared fields.
Full versus IPv4-omitted versus qualified IPv6 tunnel checksum scope; computed0 toFFFF, no ordinaryIPv6 zero. Full checksum computation/cryptographic integrity needs actual separate proof.
Perpath MTU/fallback and header subtraction, separate datagram/application segmentation, multicast receiver paths/congestion/reliability and whole source-to-function acceptance.
DPLPMTUD own layer/timers/counters/sizes/ack evidence. Only documented checksum/header/probe3/raise600/selectedIPv4base1200 proposals; actual MTU/ports/IP/PHY/clock remain unknown.
